policy: READY = pinned upstream runs locally with no account and passed the opt-in fixture acceptance in test/developer-mcp-batch-host.test.ts on this PC. NEEDS ACCOUNT = real pinned/hosted upstream exists but acceptance needs the owner's account, key, service or cost. BLOCKED = no trustworthy pinned upstream, licence/terms problem or unsafe tool surface. No paid call, login or key was used.

targets.name: Local Git
targets.reason: Unsafe tool surface for a selected repository: Git reads run repository config (core.fsmonitor, diff.external, textconv, includes) and the pinned server has commit/reset/checkout/branch tools with no read-only switch. Earlier fixture tier passed, but project use needs a real OS fence or a reviewed config-sanitized snapshot first.

targets.name: Postman
targets.cost: Postman plan limits; collection runs can call real APIs
targets.reason: Every tool calls the Postman cloud API with the owner's key. Running a collection against an owned endpoint is not a verified pinned upstream tool.
targets.ownerStep: Create a Postman API key in a test workspace that holds only a fixture collection pointing at an owned endpoint, then qualify discovery and one collection read.

targets.name: Storybook
targets.reason: Pinned addon inside an owned Storybook dev server on 127.0.0.1; dev toolset only.

targets.name: AWS
targets.auth: AWS credentials/profile for a sandbox account
targets.cost: AWS API calls can be billed; data egress
targets.reason: Reads go to the owner's AWS account; the server can also run mutating AWS CLI commands unless READ_OPERATIONS_ONLY is set and verified.
targets.ownerStep: Provide a sandbox account profile with a read-only IAM role limited to one region and resource allowlist; confirm no billable reads, then qualify one describe call.

targets.name: Azure
targets.auth: Azure sign-in (Entra ID) for a test subscription
targets.reason: Pinned build is a prerelease (4.0.0-beta.5; 4.0.0-beta.6 is newer) and every useful tool needs the owner's tenant sign-in.
targets.ownerStep: Choose a test subscription and Reader-only identity for one resource group, sign in with az login on that identity, then qualify one read.

targets.name: Google Cloud
targets.auth: gcloud CLI signed in to a test project
targets.cost: Google Cloud API charges may apply
targets.reason: Runs the owner's installed gcloud CLI with their credentials; needs a test project and Viewer-only account.
targets.ownerStep: Install gcloud, sign in with a Viewer-only account on a dedicated test project, then qualify one project describe.

targets.name: Terraform
targets.auth: None for public registry; HCP Terraform token for workspaces
targets.reason: No npm/PyPI distribution: HashiCorp ships a native binary and a Docker image. Sara recipes may start only npx, uvx, docker or node, and Docker is not available on this PC, so the docker-by-digest recipe could not be fixture-proven here (the earlier native-binary registry test is historical).
targets.ownerStep: Install Docker, then qualify docker run --rm -i hashicorp/terraform-mcp-server@<digest> stdio --tools=search_provider_docs,get_provider_details against the public registry.

targets.name: Pulumi
targets.reason: Licence problem: npm 0.2.0 declares no licence and ships no LICENSE file; the maintained hosted server has a different tool set.

targets.name: Kubernetes
targets.auth: kubeconfig for an isolated cluster namespace
targets.reason: Needs a running cluster; no cluster (kind/minikube need Docker or a VM) is available on this PC.
targets.ownerStep: Provide an isolated test cluster and a namespace-scoped read-only service-account kubeconfig; review the pinned server's read-only options against its shipped source, then qualify one pod/event read.

targets.name: Argo CD
targets.cost: Free server; cluster costs are the owner's
targets.reason: Needs a running Argo CD server and a read-only token; none here.
targets.ownerStep: Provide an Argo CD instance with a fixture application and a read-only role token; qualify with MCP_READ_ONLY=true and one application status read.

targets.name: Vercel
targets.reason: Hosted-only server with OAuth sign-in; no versioned package to pin and Sara has no hosted MCP OAuth flow.

targets.name: Netlify
targets.license: ISC (npm metadata; no LICENSE file in package)
targets.cost: Netlify plan; deploy tools can start builds
targets.reason: All tools use the owner's Netlify account; deploy/build tools exist and must stay Off.
targets.ownerStep: Create a token for a test team with one site and an existing deploy; qualify one deploy read with deploy/build tools Off.

targets.name: MongoDB
targets.reason: Upstream defect: in 3.2.2 (still latest) find with limit 0 bypasses the configured maximum (Math.min(0, max) = 0 = no limit); the real registered tool returned 20 documents against a 5-document cap.

targets.name: Redis
targets.reason: Needs a real Redis 7+ service (none on this Windows PC). The pinned server exposes 53 tools, most of them writes, and has no read-only switch, so the namespace and no-write limits must come from a Redis ACL user. A fakeredis emulator answered, but it does not enforce ACLs, so it cannot prove the limits.
targets.ownerStep: Run Redis 7+ and create an ACL user limited to ~fixture:* with +@read -@dangerous; then qualify one TTL/type read and a refused write.

targets.name: Elasticsearch and OpenSearch

elastic.deprecated: This package is deprecated. Please see the README at https://github.com/elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch for details on how to run v0.4.0 or later.

targets.reason: Needs a running OpenSearch or Elasticsearch cluster (none here). The OpenSearch server includes a generic API tool that must stay Off; Elastic's npm package is deprecated in favour of a Docker image.
targets.ownerStep: Run a single-node OpenSearch with a read-only role on one fixture index; keep the generic API tool Off and qualify one search and one mapping read.

targets.name: ClickHouse
targets.cost: Free locally; ClickHouse Cloud compute costs
targets.reason: Needs a ClickHouse server (no native Windows server here).
targets.ownerStep: Run ClickHouse with a readonly=1 profile user on a fixture database; qualify with CLICKHOUSE_ALLOW_WRITE_ACCESS=false and one EXPLAIN.

targets.name: Snowflake
targets.reason: Account-hosted MCP object; every query spends warehouse credits.
targets.ownerStep: Create a dedicated XS warehouse with a resource monitor, a read-only role and a fixture table; approve the credit spend, then qualify one bounded SELECT.

targets.name: Neon
targets.reason: Local npm package is deprecated; the hosted server needs the owner's Neon key and is not version-pinnable.
targets.ownerStep: Create a Neon API key for a test project with one branch; qualify one branch metadata read with create/delete tools Off.

targets.name: Qdrant
targets.reason: Official server with an embedded on-disk collection; read-only mode by default.

targets.name: Pinecone
targets.reason: Every query uses the owner's Pinecone project and can be billed.
targets.ownerStep: Create a key for a test project with a fixture index/namespace; approve the cost, then qualify one bounded query with upsert/admin tools Off.

targets.name: Datadog
targets.cost: Datadog plan; queries may be metered
targets.reason: Managed regional endpoint; reads use the owner's account and can be metered.
targets.ownerStep: Create scoped read-only keys for a test org with a synthetic service; qualify one bounded log query.

targets.name: Grafana
targets.reason: Needs a Grafana instance and a token; distributed as a Go binary or Docker image, and Docker is not available here.
targets.ownerStep: Run Grafana (or use a test stack) with a Viewer service-account token; qualify with --disable-write and one dashboard read.

targets.name: New Relic
targets.cost: New Relic plan; NRQL may be metered
targets.reason: Managed endpoint using the owner's account.
targets.ownerStep: Create a user key for a test account with a synthetic app; qualify one bounded NRQL read.

targets.name: PostHog
targets.reason: Managed endpoint using the owner's project; flag/experiment tools must stay Off.
targets.ownerStep: Create a scoped read-only personal key on a test project with a fixture funnel; qualify one insight read.

targets.name: LaunchDarkly
targets.reason: Every tool uses the owner's account; flag targeting tools must stay Off.
targets.ownerStep: Create a Reader-role token for a test project/environment with a fixture flag; qualify one flag read.

targets.name: Auth0
targets.auth: Auth0 device-flow sign-in to a development tenant
targets.reason: Prerelease (0.1.0-beta.19) that signs in through a browser device flow and stores tokens in the OS keychain; needs a dedicated dev tenant.

targets.name: Jenkins
targets.cost: Free server; agents cost the owner

targets.ownerStep: Provision a test controller with the pinned plugin and one finished job; give Sara a read-only token; qualify one build log read with build/trigger tools Off.

targets.name: Buildkite
targets.cost: Buildkite plan; triggers would start paid work
targets.reason: Needs the owner's org token; distributed as a Go binary or Docker image (no npx/uvx), Docker not available here. Earlier synthetic-API tier is client-contract evidence only.
targets.ownerStep: Create a read-only token for one pipeline with an existing build; install Docker; qualify with --read-only --enabled-toolsets builds,logs and one build read.
